svg.title: Eratex end-to-end order lifecycle operating flow
svg.desc: Landscape process flow from customer inquiry through sampling, inventory receipts, PCD readiness, planning, cutting, sewing, laundry scheduling, finishing, shipment readiness, and dispatch.
svg.text: Eratex End-to-End Order Lifecycle Operating Flow
Customer inquiry to dispatch, combining current build, BRD, solution-deck context, research documents, and garment operating knowledge
Scope note: current implementation is proven through Phase 5 / EOS-05 execution WIP; laundry, finishing, shipment readiness, and dispatch are target/specification flow nodes.

g.text: Current build or governed implementation surface
Approval, exception, rework, or recovery loop

svg.text: Commercial intent becomes a governed production order only after approvals, material visibility, and PCD readiness are clear.
2. Governed planning, cutting, and sewing execution
Plan truth, release gates, output capture, line loading, and WIP movement control the bulk production spine.
3. Laundry, finishing, shipment readiness, and dispatch
Wash is modeled as a first-class capacity and quality domain, not as a passive downstream finishing step.
rewash / touch-up consumes capacity and updates shipment risk
Control rails across the full lifecycle
These controls turn the process from a status tracker into a governed operating spine.

g.text: Datatex order/procurement/shipment, TMS or PLM milestones,
FastReact or platform plan, MES/laundry/WMS/FG events.
Sample and wash approval, PCD/conditional release, plan change,
line realignment, rewash, QC waiver and split shipment.
Cut qty to issued qty to net-good sewing to sewn waiting wash,
then packed, shipment-ready, and dispatched quantities.
BRYG priority, buffer health, workcenter load, wash bottleneck,
exception owner/SLA, shipment risk and OTIF learning.

svg.text: Prepared as an editable SVG and 4K PNG. Source basis: Eratex Operating Spine, BRD reconciliation, Phase 0-5 build state, wash/WIP specifications, solution deck synthesis, laundry process research, and UI prototype catalogue.
